extension.summary: Nocturne - your library after hours, explored by torchlight.
extension.description: The museum has closed for the night. Every poster, still and cover hangs on a dark plaster wall, and a warm pool of light follows your focus, gliding from frame to frame. Brass plaques, dust in the beam, a listening room under a pendant lamp. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.7 - Sets row in the Library panel; fix for controls disappearing or staying enlarged with Reduce motion on. Code clean-up for the Kodi repository checks.
